items.title: United bans AI agents from bookings as Brussels targets paid AI picks
items.excerpt: On Nov 11 the European Commission adopted a Digital Fairness Act proposal that targets paid placements in AI agent recommendations, with fines up to 6% of global turnover; the same day United rewrote its Contract of Carriage to bar AI agents from buying tickets. (United part already covered 11-12; the EU DFA paid-AI-picks proposal is the new action.)

items.title: Non-EU advertisers face 3% EU fines for unlabelled AI deep fake ads
items.excerpt: Under EU AI Act transparency rules, synthetic influencers and AI product shots that misstate an item count as deep fakes requiring labels, with fines up to 3% for non-EU advertisers; ad copy stays exempt and older AI tools must add watermarks by December 2.

items.title: Google Ads Editor 2.14 turns on AI Max by default for new Search campaigns
items.excerpt: Google Ads Editor 2.14 activates AI Max, text asset automation and Final URL expansion by default when advertisers create new Search campaigns, among 10 changes that also include retention-only bidding and loss of the Shopping local inventory toggle.

items.title: OpenAI ChatGPT Ads Updates With Intelligent Bidding, New Cost Targets, Geo-Flexibility & Product Set Filters
items.excerpt: OpenAI's weekly ChatGPT Ads update email announced intelligent bidding, new cost targets in Ads Manager, more geographic flexibility for product feed campaigns and more flexible product set filters. (Follow-up to the 11-07 Target CPA/CPC update; intelligent bidding and product-set filters are new.)

items.title: Google Ads Disallows Impersonating Public Figures With AI, Even If Disclosed
items.excerpt: Google Ads clarified its Unacceptable Business Practices policy: ads that impersonate public figures with AI-generated or AI-edited likenesses are banned even when they carry an AI disclosure, with suspension on detection and no warning.

items.title: Viant's Vanderhook Brothers Want To Make Your Next CTV Ad
items.excerpt: Viant's founders explain why the DSP bought Waymark, a generative AI video ad platform media companies used to generate more than a million local ads last year, and how AI-made creative fits its CTV buying plans, including where disclosure and AI humans draw backlash.

items.title: Custom Ad Algorithms Are Helping Schibsted Win Budgets Back From Meta
items.excerpt: Schibsted is working with Nodals AI to build custom ad optimization algorithms for its inventory, pitching performance brands that have been won over by AI campaign tools like Meta's Advantage+.

items.title: Google's AI Ad Losses Are Meta's Gain; Chatbot Ad Formats Are Starting To Multiply
items.excerpt: AdExchanger's daily roundup: advertisers worried that Google's AI Mode cannibalizes search ads are shifting budget to Meta, while chatbot ad formats multiply across AI assistants.

items.title: Media Briefing: The IAB finds AI measurement standards elusive for publishers amid platform data gaps
items.excerpt: The IAB released its AI-era attribution blueprint for crediting AI's role in conversions, but its working group hit a wall: limited data from AI platforms makes AI-driven conversions hard to measure. (Distinct from the MRC Q1 2027 draft covered 11-12.)

items.title: Mars wants to future proof impulse buys as AI is poised to take over more grocery runs
items.excerpt: Mars' global chief customer officer explains how the snack maker is preparing to sell to AI shopping agents, from LLM visibility and retail partnerships to protecting impulse purchases when agents do the grocery run.

items.title: Ad Tech Briefing: Amazon's auction trial puts agentic advertising's trust problem in focus
items.excerpt: Unsealed FTC allegations over Amazon's Sponsored Products auctions sharpen advertiser doubts about black-box AI buying tools such as Amazon Ads Agent, which automates campaign planning, buying and optimization.

items.title: Nectar launches an AI agent to automate creator discovery and outreach for brands
items.excerpt: Nectar's new Creator Agent searches for creators, checks their content and prior brand partnerships, sends personalized outreach, coordinates collaborations and tracks campaign performance for brands' influencer programs.

items.title: AI chatbots are recommending fake retail websites, study finds
items.excerpt: A Podqi study prompting ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity with shopping questions about 151 brands found the chatbots steering shoppers to impostor and risky retail sites, with Perplexity performing worst.

items.title: New Data: Holiday Shoppers Will Rely on Agents. Retailers Must Be Ready.
items.excerpt: Salesforce projects AI will drive $75.8 billion in Cyber Week spending (up 13%) and influence more than 1 in 5 holiday orders, but its survey finds 76% of shoppers don't want AI agents completing purchases for them.

items.title: New Data Shows Sales Agents Are Rescuing the Sales Cycle
items.excerpt: Salesforce's ROI Report on Sales Cloud agents, polling 24 customers, says AI sales agents save reps six hours a week on admin and 63% report better pipeline visibility and deal context (vendor-published data).

items.title: 네이버, 연내 '실행형 AI 에이전트' 출격…쇼핑·예약·결제까지 연결
items.excerpt: 네이버는 3분기 컨퍼런스콜에서 쇼핑·예약·결제를 대신 수행하는 개인형 AI 에이전트를 연내 출시하고, AI 예측 모델 적용으로 파워링크 클릭률·전환수가 개선됐으며 쇼핑 광고를 내년 상반기 거래 성과 기반 과금으로 시범 전환한다고 밝혔다.

items.title: [22회 스마트금융컨퍼런스] 문장현 비자 전무 "에이전틱 커머스 성공 열쇠는 신뢰, 인프라 제공할 것"
items.excerpt: 비자 문장현 전무는 스마트금융컨퍼런스에서 AI 에이전트가 신뢰를 기반으로 결제할 수 있도록 신원·인증·통제·거버넌스 인프라를 구축하고 있다며 에이전틱 커머스 활성화의 선결 조건으로 신뢰를 강조했다(컨퍼런스 발표).

items.title: Reddit tests AI-compiled product reviews
items.excerpt: Reddit is testing AI-generated product review overviews that convert community comments into summaries for shoppers, as it tries to recapture product-discovery traffic lost to AI Overviews and chatbots.
